name: Marg Speaks
summary: From beyond death, Marg tells of the muckshell that killed Marg and of a duty still undone. Marg asks you to find that muckshell, recover the jeweled pendant stolen from Alliance soldiers and carry it to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: What Marg Saw Near Theramore
sections.body: Near Theramore, Marg spotted Alliance soldiers camped on the beach. One of them wore a pendant studded with more gems than a soldier could ever pay for. That night Marg snuck into the camp and stole it, but a muckshell crab-man killed Marg on the way back to base. Now Marg asks you to find that muckshell, recover the pendant and bring it to Nazeer in Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: What Nazeer Makes of It
sections.body: Nazeer is startled to learn that a soldier of Stormwind wore this pendant. You have uncovered the secret of how Marg died, yet the pendant is a new mystery, and Nazeer warns it may have dire effects on both the Alliance and the Horde.

faq.q: Who is Marg and how did Marg die?
faq.answer: Marg stole a jeweled pendant from Alliance soldiers camped near Theramore, then was killed by a muckshell crab-man on the way back to base.

faq.q: Where did the jeweled pendant come from?
aliases: where did the pendant come from
faq.answer: A soldier in an Alliance camp on the beach near Theramore wore it, studded with far more gems than a soldier could pay for. Marg snuck in that night and stole it.

aliases: where do i take the pendant
